items.why: AI steps moved from fixed 2/10/20 credits by model tier to credits that follow the actual model call cost; Free-plan credit refresh wording moved from next day to next month.

record.short: AI steps no longer cost a fixed 2, 10 or 20 credits by model class; they now cost what the model call actually cost, turned into credits.

items.why: A scope sentence on the data-residency premium was removed and worked examples gained a USD label; no price changed.
A 14-day trial button was removed from one plan; no price change.
Feature description copy was stripped from the plan cards; the AI request and credit allowances still appear in the comparison table.
The Early Stage startup discount rose from up to 93% off to up to 96% off; plan prices were unchanged and the page layout was reorganised.

record.short: Intercom’s startup discount went from up to 93% off to up to 96% off, with 1 year of Fin free.
record.headline: Intercom raised the discount for qualifying startups from up to 93% off to up to 96% off.
record.who: Startups under $10M raised with 15 employees or fewer that apply to the Early Stage program; standard list prices are unchanged.
record.read: A deeper startup discount looks like a push to win early-stage accounts while list prices stay put. It is a program change, not a change to what most customers pay.
record.caveat: The pricing page was also reorganised, with the helpdesk and Fin shown as separate line items at the same prices.

items.why: The invoice and wire transfer FAQ was rewritten; invoicing is still limited to annual Business and Enterprise.
Enterprise+ now shows $45 USD per user per month on annual billing, where it was previously contact sales.
The Spot discount on Standard rose from 30% to 50% off, but Spot is now listed only for GLM 5.3 instead of several models.

record.short: Spot discount vs Standard went from 30% off to 50% off, but the Spot table now lists only GLM 5.3.

items.why: Only navigation menu labels changed.
Duplicated button and testimonial renders were removed and plan type headers added; no pricing change.
Only the order of the sign-up form legal text changed.
A Black Friday offer was added: 3 months of the Puzzle platform free with Catch-Up or Full Service bookkeeping, ending Dec 4.

promo.text: Black Friday: 3 months of Puzzle free with Catch-Up or Full Service bookkeeping. Ends Dec 4.

items.why: DM and comment automations, previously capped by plan, can now be added for $5/mo per additional automation on the paid plans.

record.short: DM and comment automations stay capped by plan, but extra ones can now be bought at $5/mo each.

items.why: The 25% off exit offer was replaced by a Black Friday 63% off code.

promo.text: Black Friday: 63% off with a checkout code, replacing the earlier 25% off offer.

items.why: Business tier monthly prices rose by $1 on the 2,500, 5,000 and unlimited chat packages and Agency rose by $2.

record.short: Business chat packages rose $29 → $30, $53 → $54 and $156 → $157 a month; Agency from $544 → $546.

items.why: The page showed two versions in one run; both differ only in how discount information is presented, and no price changed.
Added a note that LLM usage cost depends on the selected model; still billed separately.
The student plan changed from everything Plus offers to most of Plus with a few student limits.

record.short: The free student plan went from everything in Plus to most of Plus, with a few student limits.

items.why: An empty reviews block was removed.
A Brand Kits row was added to the plan comparison.
Only a navigation link was added.
Call-to-action button copy changed.
The pricing page headline and subtitle were reworded.

record.short: Mailercloud’s Email API entry price went from $7/mo to $10/mo.

items.why: A duplicate list of comparison links was removed from the footer.

The Black Friday annual offer changed from Buy 1 Year, Get 1 Year Free to $1 today, then $500 on day 14 for 2 years; both versions seen differ only in the countdown timer, so the test flag looks incidental.

promo.text: Black Friday: year two free, $1 today, then $500 on day 14 for 2 years; cancel before day 14 to avoid the $500.
